summary:
**Weekly Digest Summary**

A BofA AI bubble warning (drawing 1990s fiber-optic parallels) and CoreWeave credit stress triggered a $260B+ risk-off unwind, hammering high-multiple AI, cloud, and crypto-adjacent names including PLTR, MSTR (-9.6%), MARA (-9.6%), and SNOW (-8.4%), pushing VIX above 22. Simultaneous Middle East escalation (Yemen strikes, Saudi intercepts) and a 17M-barrel US SPR solicitation drove decisive safe-haven rotation into Defense (RTX +3.7%, LMT +3.6%) and Energy (CVX +2.6%), while AAPL bucked the selloff on iPhone demand, China's $37B subsidy tailwind, and Berkshire support. All five signals remain intact entering day 4 — **BUY RTX, LMT, AAPL; SELL PLTR, MSTR**.
